description: This file defines the `LogNode` interface, which specifies methods for a logging system that outputs log data to one or more targets. It includes a method `println` used to print log information with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for a logging system component capable of outputting logs and chaining to other LogNode instances.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Instructs the first LogNode in the chain to print the provided log data, including log priority, tag, message, and optional throwable.
